verification.scenario: With a supported complete arrangement export containing shared form, independent parts and all bindings, import it into an explicitly confirmed compatible anonymous browser destination; reconstruct every declared musical field and association without silently merging extra destination songs.

With an existing anonymous browser library and a supported v1 backup, confirm migration and import; preserve original identities, ordering, repeats, triad meaning and associations while recording deterministic generated measure and event mappings and retaining a pre-migration recovery copy.
With a retained migration receipt and an interrupted identical v1 browser import, retry that import; reuse the generated identities without duplicating migrated events.

With valid durable data and unknown schema, duplicate identities or dangling bindings in an imported file, request import; refuse before activation and preserve both original source and previous durable destination.
With a backup containing out-of-measure duration or unsupported attachment capability, request import; refuse without truncating or dropping declared content.
With a valid recovery copy and failed migration activation, confirm a supported import; retain original source and previous durable revision without reporting import success.

With selected anonymous songs, real sign-in and a valid collision-free preview, confirm claim; acknowledge complete authorized song boundaries and retain the source until authorized service reconstruction is verified.
With a committed principal-bound claim receipt and lost response, retry the same command; reconcile without duplicate songs or revisions.

With a private claim identity collision, request unmodified claim; refuse before mutation and offer explicit consistently remapped copy-as-new preview, whose confirmation leaves the source and existing destination unchanged.
With a prepared private claim preview, cancel confirmation; create no private content and retain the source.
With private import containing purported foreign ownership grants, confirm as principal A; derive ownership from A's trusted session and grant no access from imported values.
With current private read/export capability, export a declared song; include complete authorized musical content and provenance but no credentials, session material or authority-conferring grants.
With private export capability revoked before admission, request export; refuse without exposing retained content and preserve only protected principal-bound pending work.

With a service multi-song import declaring separate song and preference boundaries, fail one commit; report exact completed receipts and remaining work without calling the batch wholly successful or damaging earlier acknowledgements.
With a purge receipt and an old backup proposing the same destination identity, request restoration; refuse resurrection and preserve unrelated songs.

With two independent native installations and a complete current song including lyrics, phrase data, exact hand/register pitches and owned PDF bytes, export from A and import into populated B; compare every independently expected reconstructed value, preserve B's existing music and allow editing and re-export of B's independent copy.

With a complete ordered native set containing shared required musical definitions, export and import into another installation; preserve exact set order, each supported field and internal reference using one consistent destination mapping and complete required PDF bytes.

With the same native source identities already present at the destination, confirm another deliberate import preview; create only new independent identities without overwriting, updating, merging or replacing existing content.
With a native import committed and its response lost, retry the same command; return its existing receipt and mapping without another copied song or set.
With a valid native import preview and existing music, cancel; preserve source file and complete destination without activation.

With malformed, truncated, oversized, unknown-version, unsupported-capability, duplicate-ID or dangling native input, request import; refuse complete activation with an actionable reason and preserve the original file and previous library.
With a native set import whose required PDF bytes are incomplete or integrity verification fails, request activation; refuse without a partial set, broken attachment or durable-library changes.

With a valid native import and storage exhaustion or required attachment publication failure, confirm; acknowledge no partial import and preserve all previous durable music while reconciling any ambiguous command result.

With a native song's retained history and app/hardware preferences, export its current acknowledged musical revision; include source provenance and complete musical reconstruction data but not local revision history, personal preferences, actual hardware authority or account/session authority.

With an existing lease and a failed background authorization request, process that failure; grant no renewal and lock whenever authority is unknown.
With a retained authorization deadline and detected clock rollback, evaluate private access; lock instead of granting additional time.
With retained private work and uncertain trustworthy elapsed time, request private access; lock rather than assume an unexpired lease.

With an otherwise unexpired offline lease and permissions downgraded remotely, reconnect; require fresh resource checks before exposure or replay and apply the current lower capability without automatic write replay.

With protected pending work and current permission revalidated for the same stable principal, request draft recovery online; expose only the authorized scope for explicit revision comparison and apply no queued mutation automatically.
With principal A's retained record and a newly authenticated independent principal B, request recovery of A's record; refuse display, import, export and replay while preserving A's protected record.
With the same reauthenticated principal but revoked song permission, request retained-draft recovery; refuse access and replay while permitting explicit local deletion of the protected record.

With private pending work and a failed save followed by failed authorized export, confirm voluntary logout with retention; terminate the session, lock content and preserve the protected record without forcing export or discarding work.
With principal A's protected pending work, switch to principal B; close A's context before opening B's and expose none of A's content, keys or drafts to B.
With private-session cleanup and an original anonymous library, expire the private session; preserve the anonymous source without turning protected private work into anonymous content.
